data.body: CROSS-EPIC NOTE from 411b-a047-18de-4516: 411b's threshold-breach auto-bug-creation (SC5) is one of 69e8's input signals. Auto-created bugs include a 4-field structured blurb (WHAT/THRESHOLD/CONTEXT/NEXT_STEP) with context about why mutation testing is used in the project. 69e8's negative-example extraction during /dso:fix-bug Phase G will process these bugs the same as human-filed bugs — no special handling required. The bugs include content-hash dedup tags (mutation-breach-<sha>) scoped per-stack-per-source-file, so recurring root-causes naturally dedup across PRs.
